title: Why I learned Quarto
text: When I first started using Quarto, VS Code, and GitHub, I found it challenging. Since I had gone through three different computers, I was really struggling and often completed things too quickly and automatically without fully understanding them. After purchasing a Mac and adjusting to some of the differences, I found that my coding journey became much smoother, and I thoroughly enjoyed learning how to complete the assignments.

title: Why I learned Quarto
section: What advice would I give to someone starting out in Psych 390
text:
What advice would I give to someone starting out in Psych 390
Some advice I would give to someone taking PSYCH 390 with no coding experience would be to read everything slowly. Take your time, don’t focus on memorizing, and try to understand what each command really does. I noticed that at the start, I would often do things really fast and out of instinct. With this class, I believe patience is truly a virtue.
A recommendation I would have is to make sure you have a good, functional laptop, as I went through three throughout the course, which made things more challenging. I also really enjoyed interacting with my peers and instructors, and as challenging as this course could be, I found it really satisfying when I was able to achieve the end goal.

Research Interests
My research interests are in complex PTSD and how trauma impacts individuals. I hope to specialize in evidence-based approaches such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). Additionally, I am interested in relationships and attachment.
